about_body:
An open, bilingual viewer for Santiago de Cali's public geospatial data (IDESC) — 350+ municipal layers you can browse, color and extrude by their own data, and explore in 3D relief.

A civic, open-source tool by Recovered Factory.
about_riff: The saying goes: “Cali es Cali, lo demás es loma” — Cali is Cali, the rest is the hills. Here, the rest is map.
view_3d_hint: Extrude by height (floors, trees) and color contours by elevation
base_hint: Show or hide the base map
theme_hint: Map theme: basemap, relief, and data colors move together
extrude_hint: Extrude this layer by a numeric field
color_by_hint: Color this layer by an attribute's value
line_width_hint: Adjust the line or outline width
numeric_field: Numeric field (can be used for styling)
click_hint: Click a feature to see its attributes
attribution: Data: IDESC – Alcaldía de Santiago de Cali
